audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The basepoint-component spectral label need not define an open set; Positive eigenfunctions cannot be selected on all components at the smallest component eigenvalue; The Robin variational boundary term lacks a factor one-half
limitations: P1 — The basepoint-component spectral label need not define an open set — Counterevidence and scope: Not a counterexample to Theorems 4.3 or 1.1: this particular epigraph has a trivial ample decomposition. The demonstration is analytic and requires no thin-neck spectral limit or numerical eigenvalue computation.

P1 — The basepoint-component spectral label need not define an open set — Counterevidence: The original epigraph is itself ample. The same example is not claimed to satisfy every extra expanding-ball premise in the later(4.14) contradiction sequence; only the implication from smooth original-domain convergence alone is challenged.

P2 — Positive eigenfunctions cannot be selected on all components at the smallest component eigenvalue — Counterevidence and scope: The intended exhaustion conclusion is not refuted; p.18 already uses a component selection compatible with the local repair.

P2 — Positive eigenfunctions cannot be selected on all components at the smallest component eigenvalue — Counterevidence: The final connected-domain conclusion is not refuted and the source's low-eigenvalue component construction at p18 supplies the needed local alternative.
P3 — The Robin variational boundary term lacks a factor one-half — Counterevidence and scope: Dirichlet case is unaffected; no counterexample to the corrected multiplicity proposition is claimed.

P3 — The Robin variational boundary term lacks a factor one-half — Counterevidence: For a>=0 and minimizeru>=0, the incorrect2a boundary condition still implies the target subsolution inequality -a u<=0. Since f0>=h, the downstream high-solution comparison remains available.

P4 — The initial constant upper envelope must be at least one — Counterevidence and scope: Uses the multiplicity construction with the corrected Robin energy; does not presume convergence from an arbitrary small constant. The intended hair-trigger upper bound survives the repair.

P4 — The initial constant upper envelope must be at least one — Counterevidence: When M<=1 comparison with P_t1 proves the required upper bound without equality; when M>1 the supersolution limit identification applies.
Limitations: The reviewed source is an author preprint, not the publisher PDF; no version equivalence certified.
Limitations: Full textual reading does not independently reprove all imported elliptic estimates, mixed-boundary regularity, uniform smoothing, or variable-boundary convergence.
Limitations: Lemma 4.5 normalized supersolution compactness is a remaining dependency; no additional definitive counterexample was established.
Limitations: Bounded publisher/arXiv/author-page search identified no correction or executable supplement; absence of code is not a mathematical defect.
Limitations: Native helpers are bounded auxiliaries, not independent acceptance reviewers or independently verified Pro backends.
Limitations: A helper's initial outer process exit code was unavailable and remains unknown; its child pdftotext exit 0 was observed.
Limitations: Exact per-image inspection timestamps were not separately captured and are not reconstructed.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
